title: Women Who Need CPR Are Less Likely To Get It
description:
It's a troubling statistic. Women are 14% less likely to receive CPR in public emergencies. (39% of women get CPR compared to 45% for men). 

Often, people fear touching a stranger's chest and hurting them while administering CPR. Good Samaritan laws protect people who step in to give reasonable emergency help. Everyone deserves help in an emergency. Learning CPR and acting fast can save a life!

More info: sandiego.gov/sdprojectheartbeat/training
